text:
marie: Quick heads-up — PR #4822 is ready for docs review. It updates release notes for a model catalog change (gptx-3 -> gptx-3a) and adds a migration guide for quantized checkpoints.
sam: Thanks — assigning reviewers @jon and @priya. Can we get the CI/docs preview link before we schedule merge?
ci-bot: docs preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.internal/changes/4822 — build passed ✅
jon: Skimmed the PR. One immediate ask: add a short callout about function-calling behavior change (routing now requires explicit content-type) — otherwise users may see nondeterministic tool routing.
priya: Agreed. Also adding a small Python SDK migration snippet for the guide. Will paste in a sec.
priya: ```python
# before
client.generate(model="gptx-3", prompt=...)
# after
client.generate(model="gptx-3a", prompt=..., runtime_options={"kernel":"int8"})
```
marie: Nice snippet. @sam — can we gate the merge until after the dedicated canary run at 10:15 PT? I'd like a 20m hold after canary to catch any quick telemetry regressions.
sam: Yes — plan to merge after canary finishes and a 20m watch window. I'll update the PR description with the merge window and hold. Also please watch i18n job; it flakes occasionally.
ci-bot: i18n job rerun passed ✅
docs-bot: Tiny editorial nit: in the migration guide step 2 the wording uses 'must' for a non-breaking optimization. Suggest change to 'recommended' to avoid implying mandatory action.
jon: Good catch. Change 'must' -> 'recommended' in step 2 improves tone.
marie: I'll push that wording change to the branch now. Anyone else to add as reviewer?
sam: Add @eng-runtime to double-check the kernel suggestion and runtime options.
marie: Added eng-runtime. Draft changelog blurb I put in the PR: "gptx-3 deprecated; gptx-3a available with improved latency and an int8 quantized runtime — see migration guide for SDK and CLI steps." Objections?
jon: LGTM.
priya: LGTM, please ensure the SDK snippet is exact copy-paste.
sam: +1 from my side. Merge gated until canary completes.
marie: Plan: merge after canary (10:15 PT) + 20m hold. Final window 10:40–11:00 PT. I'll post a final comment with the preview link and the timeline.
marie: Post-merge note: if we get rollback requests, we can temporarily alias model back to gptx-3; adding rollback details to the migration guide.
priya: Added a rollback CLI example: 
priya: ```bash
# temporarily map alias back to old model
redwood model alias set gptx-3a gptx-3 --force
```
marie: Perfect — thanks everyone :rocket: 
sam: I'll monitor canary metrics and call out any token-rate or latency spikes.
jon: Also adding a quick test snippet for function-calling in the guide to show content-type header usage.
marie: Done for now. I'll merge once the canary and hold pass. If anything pops, reopen the PR. Thanks all.
